history.recommendation_text: 1. The Board reiterates its recommendation that the Administration recognize the actual costs of self- constructed items of property, plant and equipment that qualify for recognition as assets.
history.reference_raw: A/72/5 (Vol. II), chap. II, for the year ended 30 June 2017; para. 26
history.administration_response: Construction projects in the peacekeeping missions commencing 1 July 2018 are valued using actual costs. The commencement date for special political missions was 1 January 2018. Two workshops were held for both peacekeeping missions and special political missions in the first half of 2018 to train staff on the use of Umoja to capture actual costs of self- constructed assets.
history.board_assessment: The recommendation has been implemented. Actual costs will be recognized starting 1 July 2018.
